title: DADE: code, data and results for a leakage-audited evaluation of intrusion detection and business impact analysis for continuity prioritization (revision 2)
description: Code, coded rating data, results, reproduction reports and the full text of the expert judgment forms and consent statements (Arabic with English translation; docs/forms) for the manuscript "Intrusion detection and business impact analysis for continuity prioritization: a leakage-audited evaluation of an analytic hierarchy process rule against simpler baselines" and for the MSc thesis on the same study (Northern Border University). The four public datasets are not included; see README.md for their sources and SHA-256 hashes. Code is under the MIT licence; results, documentation and forms are under CC BY 4.0 (LICENSES.md). The rating files contain coded raters only; the named form exports are not deposited.
